name: Trusted Autonomy
principle: The AI acts first on what it may decide and brings the person exactly the decisions that are theirs.
state_description: Work moves without you, and when a question reaches you it is one only you should answer, with what you need to answer it.
hints_of_measurement: No human-only step is taken alone, and few asks turn out to be unnecessary.

name: Same Assistant Everywhere
principle: A person gets the same assistant, with the same answer to the same request, on every Quest surface.
state_description: A request made in chat, in a scheduled task or in the app is treated the same way, and an improvement is felt on every surface.
hints_of_measurement: The same labelled requests sent through each surface give matching answers.
